slides.label: STATUS: PLAYER-REPORTED
slides.title:
GTA 6 has a
UFO abduction.
slides.body: Guides say a real alien encounter waits near the Starlet Motel. It only shows up after 2 AM.

slides.label: EXHIBIT A: THE CAR
slides.title:
An empty car.
Doors wide open.
slides.body: On a rural road in Kelly County: a car with its lights on, doors open, clothes on the ground. Follow the headlights into the woods.

slides.label: EXHIBIT B: THE BEAM
slides.title:
Help the stranger.
Then you're next.
slides.body: A UFO beam lights up the trees. A stranger on the ground asks you to fetch their car. Walk back, and the UFO takes you instead.

slides.label: VERDICT: OPEN CASE
slides.title:
And it's only
the beginning.
slides.body: One guide says a dream puzzle follows, then a facility near Key Lento. It also warns the car doesn't spawn every time.
slides.cta: Send this to the friend who still hunts the Chiliad UFO.
